scope: Only original development data. Reuse fixed lot/hash-component train/tune/audit. Audit has already been observed and is exploratory, not a new independent final test.
hypothesis: Adding explicit nonlinear line-consensus descriptors to unchanged RF can improve Scratch detection without merely shifting normal errors to other defect labels.

prior_feature_audit.caveat: PCA eigenvalue anisotropy is mathematically derived from existing covariance for nondegenerate samples, not new information. The experiment tests the whole six-feature block; gains cannot be attributed uniquely to PCA or any component.

features.ties: Maximum failed count; retain first ascending angle, phase, then lowest bin.
features.coordinate_system: Original cell centres, same cell unit for x/y strip geometry. PCA uses original independent H/W-normalized coordinates.
features.degenerate_rule: PCA=0 for n<2; five strip features=0 for n<3; two distinct failures retain covariance-derived PCA anisotropy 1.

controls: Same train rows, labels, seed, RF hyperparameters, class order and argmax decision. Only append frozen feature block. sqrt feature sampling yields floor(sqrt(71))=floor(sqrt(77))=8 features at each node.

split.grouping: Connected components joining lots via exact image hashes; no lot/hash/component crosses roles.
split.use: Fit each RF only on train once; emit tune probabilities; wait for PR threshold freeze then emit existing-audit probabilities. No RF train+tune refit in this ablation.

cnn_reference: Existing round2 screen baseline BN-natural 7-epoch raw logits, seeds42/123/2026, trained on exactly the same train rows. Convert with stable float64 softmax; do not retrain, choose biases, or imply conversion runtime is model inference.
analysis_rule: Report all seed-wise and paired differences. Consistent joint point-estimate improvement requires every seed: Scratch TP not lower, total normal FP and normal-to-Scratch FP not higher, Macro-F1 drop <=0.02; at least one strict Scratch TP increase and summed normal-to-Scratch FP strictly lower. Failing this rule is a tradeoff/no qualifying repair, not a hidden success.

uncertainty.method: Paired lot/hash-component bootstrap for mean-across-seed Scratch recall and normal error deltas, preserving each wafer across seeds.
uncertainty.limitation: Exploratory conditional intervals, not selection-adjusted or independent confirmation; seeds share the same wafers.

error_strata.low_confidence: maximum class probability <0.5, descriptive only; no decision rule changes
error_strata.label_ambiguity: Flag exact hashes with conflicting labels within original development only; do not relabel or remove.

groups: RF-original true Scratch missed to none
RF-original true Scratch missed to Loc/other
True Scratch with lowest RF-original maximum class probability
gallery.selection: First 3 by sha256(geometry-gallery|source_row), except low-confidence group sorted by max probability then source row. Empty groups explicitly shown; overlap across groups allowed.
gallery.annotation: Computed label, pixels, dimensions, failure count and model outputs; any visual causal explanation labeled conjecture.

stop_rule: Exactly two fixed feature sets times three seeds = six new RF fits maximum. No result-driven feature edits, hyperparameter expansion, split changes, or new CNN training. Preserve negative findings. No new official-test evaluation or model promotion.

amendments.reason: Independent pre-training review: retain covariance-derived PCA anisotropy for two failures; only strip features require three. Prevent min-count gating from being misdescribed as pure moment re-expression.
amendments.changed_parameters: Degenerate PCA handling only; fixed 36x2 strip grid and six-feature block unchanged.
